title: The Little Dragon Who Couldn't Sleep

pages.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy cave on top of a hill, lived a little dragon named Pip.
Every night, Pip counted the stars. One, two, three... but Pip could never fall asleep.
So Pip flew up, up, up into the sky, and asked the moon for a lullaby.
The moon sang softly, and Pip's eyes grew heavy. Goodnight, little dragon. Goodnight, Maya.
